Team — copying the core asks from StormGate and the proposed times. They want a hands-on prompt session + a short load test (bursts ~350 RPS for 10 minutes). Key points and proposed plan: 

1) Model / routing
- Customer will start on an Llama3-13B variant (unquantized) for prompt tuning. For load windows we can route to a quantized 13B-4bit variant to reduce GPU memory and increase concurrency.

2) Dedicated vs hosted for load windows
- Recommendation: provision a short-lived dedicated pool for the official load window (10m bursts). Rationale: predictable SLOs and clean metrics for their evaluation.
- If we go hosted + quota bump: need a 72h lead time and a clear model pin (we may not get consistent tail latency).

3) Quota & token budget
- Based on StormGate estimates (avg token per request ~420 tokens), 350 RPS x 600s -> 21,000,000 tokens in the burst. We'll validate numbers with the attached spreadsheet.
- Action: submit quota bump ticket for their org to raise per-minute token limit and per-route QPS. If we do dedicated, create a temporary capacity reservation (4x GPU T4-equivalent) for the day.

4) Operational prep (pre-week tasks)
- Steph: confirm slot with customer and share prep doc + top 5 prompts (done once confirmed).
- Priyom: draft capacity reservation request + estimated cost and ETA.
- Rishi: prepare a short test harness for the 350 RPS burst (script + tracing flags) and a fallback plan to cap at 250 RPS if we see instability.
- Marissa: offer to join the session for routing/fallback and observability walkthrough if available.

Please add any missing items; I'll send the calendar invite to Jordan after we pick the final slot.

—Stephanie
